purpose: Operational instructions for source and AI-assisted style curation, not proof of expert labels
unit: The exact shown text. Full-candidate review does not imply that the original publisher document was complete.

style_labels.official: A document or passage that performs an administrative, legal or business act: request, order, agreement, notice of obligation or formal correspondence. A casual question about a law is not automatically official.
style_labels.scientific: Explanatory or research prose presenting concepts, methods, evidence and reasoned findings. Educational-scientific explanations are included. A copied calculation exercise or lesson timetable requires separate genre review.
style_labels.publicistic: Public reporting, commentary, persuasion or discussion of socially relevant events for a broad audience. A political topic alone does not determine this label.
style_labels.literary: Narrative or poetic construction of scenes, characters and imagery. A reader's informal reaction to a novel is not automatically literary prose.
style_labels.colloquial: Direct informal interaction, personal questions, answers, advice, reactions and experiential reviews, including written online conversation. Polite address alone does not turn a formal explanatory passage into colloquial speech.

decision_order: Read the entire shown unit and record whether it is a full candidate or an excerpt.
Check extraction damage, truncation, interface material, remaining addresses and identifiable contact data separately from style.
Identify communicative function and register using the text, not the publisher, topic, sentiment or star rating.
Distinguish the writer's own interaction from a predominantly quoted song, reference definition, exercise, advertisement or copied article.
If a predominant style cannot be established, retain an ambiguity reason rather than force a class or automatically relabel it.
Bind the decision to the original and shown text hashes. Record any bounded removal explicitly.

retain: A personal request for programming help even when it contains technical terms or a short error message.
A personal question about study materials, as distinct from a copied assignment prompt.
A review describing the writer's experience, including negative feedback, emotion and natural code switching.
A direct reply on political, religious, scientific or other topics when its informal interactive register is clear.
quarantine_if_uncertain: Neutral institutional, product or place descriptions with promotional wording and no clear personal interaction.
Polished literary criticism or public argument whose written register cannot confidently be called colloquial.
An isolated aphorism, list, dictionary definition, copied news paragraph or long lyric quote.
Text cut inside a word, incoherent text, or a passage with unresolved address/contact flags.

preservation: Keep meaningful Kazakh letters, spelling variation, slang, names, dates, punctuation and emojis. Do not paraphrase data to make models easier to train.
claims_not_checked: Style review does not verify factual, medical, legal, political or other claims and does not endorse the author's views.
evidence_limits: Assistant decisions are AI-assisted curation. They are not independent human expert labels. Targeted short-text selection does not estimate the corpus-wide label error rate.
status: Consolidated after the initial curation rounds; freeze before subsequent reference annotation, not a retrospective preregistration.
